Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student in the QuizWhiz application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Student entity.

quizAttemptIds.description: References to QuizAttempt entities for this student. (Relationship: Student 1:N QuizAttempt)

Professor.title: Professor
Professor.description: Represents a professor in the QuizWhiz application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Professor entity.

Quiz.title: Quiz
Quiz.description: Represents a quiz with multiple questions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Quiz entity.

authorId.description: The ID of the professor who created the quiz.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: Represents a question in a quiz.

options.description: The possible answer options for the question.

correctAnswer.description: The correct answer to the question.

QuizAttempt.title: QuizAttempt
QuizAttempt.description: Represents a student's attempt to take a quiz.

id.description: Unique identifier for the QuizAttempt entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the Student who took the quiz.

studentName.description: The name of the student who took the quiz.

quizId.description: Reference to the Quiz being attempted.

quizTopic.description: The topic of the quiz that was attempted.

score.description: The student's score on the quiz attempt.

submittedAt.description: The date and time the quiz was submitted.

answers.description: The answers for this quiz attempt.

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description: Represents a student's answer to a specific question in a quiz attempt.

selectedAnswer.description: The answer option selected by the student.

correctAnswer.description: The correct answer for the question.

isCorrect.description: Indicates whether the answer is correct.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Can be a Student or a Professor. Uses a `role` field to distinguish.
Stores quizzes created by professors. Readable by all authenticated users.
Stores all quiz attempts from all students. Student can only write their own and read their own. Professor can read all.
